steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! Didn't he promise that black thing he wouldn't kill us? What a scumbag! Promises mean nothing to him.
She probably forgets she's not the honest type either. The same can be said about you.
But now is not a good time for mockery. The raincoat men are more powerful than you expected. The black flame rages on, lashing at all of you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Argh... The contamination here can penetrate Chief's shackles?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is this happening again?!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I won't let it happen again!

steps.content: You brush past the two affected Sinners. And when you reach out your hand, the shackles, powered by your strong will, break the restraints and penetrate the man's chest.
The black flame restraining the Sinners disappears, and the man, now on one knee, coughs up blood, grabbing the red spike that has pieced his chest.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The shackles have grown stronger?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did it work?!

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: ...Well, well. Now I know what happened... It's you... Quite a feat for a defective like you...
His hand clutching the spike bursts into black flame, which roars as it rushes into your field of vision, a noise so loud that it blocks out all other sounds.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Thank you. I've found the answer.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You saw it, that <color=#fb9259>great existence</color>... right?

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You were supposed to be its food. Instead, you consumed it. It's you who destroyed the Black Ring I had nurtured in the West District...

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Don't worry. I didn't come here for revenge. Unbelievable as it may sound, but you've earned your <color=#fb9259>eligibility</color>.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Today, and maybe for a long time to come, I will not stand in your way. Keep up the good work.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is a Corpus? What do you mean by it being awakened? Is this Black Ring a result of its awakening? What's in it? Why does it cause Mania?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why did you say I was supposed to its food and I... consumed it instead?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Am I...

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: No no no... Too late, the door for information exchange has closed. I've found my answer without your help, you have to find yours on your own.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You can do this. The answer is right here...
He smiles, his voice close by your ear.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Parma</color>. Remember the name. We'll meet again, as long as you don't get yourself killed.
A black mist rises, and you're hurled back to reality. The two Sinners grab you. Where the man stood a minute ago, a black ball of fire is all that's been left behind.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He ran away?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Should we give chase?
No... He's no longer here. Even if we caught up with him, he wouldn't give us the answer.
The howling monsters in the park coalesce, and surge into the depths of the Black Ring, in the direction where the phantom, who got burned by your shackles, went.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You've been held back by the man for quite some time. Phantom Hamel must have absorbed tons of Corruptors. She must have grown huge...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: We'll beat her, we have to.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Do you know her actual location?
The shackles have her remembered. You feel a shooting pain that comes with the mental connection. It guides you to look at the tallest structure in the amusement park.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Somewhere where every corner of the park can be clearly seen.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The Ferris wheel?
